title: The Betabox
description: A Modpack that attempts to recreate Minecraft's beta without removing modern features.
body:
A Minecraft Modpack that attempts to add back the features of Minecraft's Beta without removing the modern features.

Adds Nightmares, the Old Crafting recipes, the textures and feel of the beta, no hunger or xp, and a lot more!
